200.answer: A Travel Pass is activated immediately once you add it and can be used for the duration included in the pass. You should add the pass the day your trip starts, before you arrive. The pass is valid until 11:59 p.m. (ET) on its expiry date. You can confirm the expiry date in MyBell by checking the My travel features section. Travel Passes are compatible with Roam Better and take priority over Roam Better when travelling in an eligible destination, meaning you won't be charged the Roam Better fee if you're using an active Travel Pass. Once the pass expires, you revert to your regular roaming option, which is either Roam Better or pay-per-use rates. Travel Passes include unlimited calling and texting within your destination and back to Canada, plus access to the data from your rate plan. If you call outside of your roaming destination (other than Canada), you will be charged $1.45/minute. Data Travel Pass offers will no longer be available as of March 19, 2026.

[How do Travel Passes work?](javascript:void(0))A Travel Pass is activated immediately once you add it and can be used for the duration included in the pass. Make sure you add the pass the day your trip starts, before you arrive. The pass is valid until 11:59 p.m. (ET) on the date it expires. You can confirm the expiry date anytime in MyBell by checking the My travel features section. Travel Passes are compatible with Roam Better and take priority over Roam Better when travelling in an eligible destination (i.e., if you’re using an active Travel Pass in an eligible destination, you won’t be charged the Roam Better fee for the duration of your pass). Once the pass expires, you revert to your regular roaming option – Roam Better or pay-per-use rates. [What’s included in a Travel Pass?](javascript:void(0))Travel Passes include unlimited calling and texting within your destination and back to Canada, plus access to the data from your rate plan. [Are there any charges when making calls to destinations outside my Travel Pass destination (other than Canada)?](javascript:void(0))If calling outside of your roaming destination, you will be charged $1.45/minute (e.g., if roaming in Italy and calling France, you will be charged $1.45/minute). Please note: Data Travel Pass offers will no longer be available as of March 19, 2026. Have more questions? snippets.text: # What is a Data Travel Pass and how do I use it? Please note: Data Travel Pass offers will no longer be available as of March 19, 2026. What is a Data Travel Pass?  - collapsed A Data Travel Pass provides a fixed amount of data for you to use on your mobile phone or device while travelling outside Canada. It helps you manage the cost of data roaming. Without a data pass, you can use data while roaming at the pay-per-use rate for the country you're travelling to. You can use a maximum of $100 of data per billing period, after which you will have to purchase a data pass to continue using data while roaming. If you subscribe to Roam Better, you’ll need a Data Travel Pass to use data in destinations not covered by Roam Better. To see travel add-ons and rates, go to [bell.ca/travel](http://www.bell.ca/Mobility/Coverage_map)and select your destination. Purchasing a Data Travel Pass  - collapsed You can purchase a data pass up to 30 days before you leave the country, or any time while you're travelling. The pass activates once you start using data while roaming, and then you can use it for 30 days before it expires. If you know you will need more data than the data pass, you can purchase more than one. Then when you use all the data in the first pass, the second one will automatically activate. To purchase a data pass on your mobile device: * Launch the [MyBell app](http://support.bell.ca/Mobility/Self_Serve_options/Bell-Self-serve-app). * Select your device. * Select Travel & roaming . * Enter a destination in the search bar. * Select the country from the drop-down list. * Select View travel features . * Choose a data pass and select Continue . * Follow the prompts to complete your purchase.
